---
title: "MN Congressional Districts"
---

```{r}
# to efficiently download official U.S. Census Bureau boundaries directly into R
# without the need to download the files manually
library(tigris)
options(tigris_class = "sf", tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)
```


Fetch MN congressional districts data
```{r}
mn_districts <- tigris::congressional_districts(state = "MN", cb = TRUE, year = 2024)
class(mn_districts)
```

Create MN congressional districts map
```{r}
all_mn <- mn_districts |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf() +
  theme_map()
all_mn
```

Zoom on Twin Cities
```{r}
twin <- all_mn +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-94.0, -92.5), ylim = c(44.5, 45.5), expand = FALSE)
twin
```
Show both
```{r}
all_mn + twin + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1,2))
```
